overloads.semanticRole: Sets the number of break levels (and optionally which level triggers a page break) to activate break processing for the next report printed with PRINT SELECTION.

constraints: Must be called, together with ACCUMULATE, before every report (via PRINT SELECTION) for which break processing is wanted -- these two commands activate break processing.
The form must have at least as many Break areas as the number passed in level; extra Break areas are ignored.
